description:
Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to support or sponsor any U.S. immigration benefit (such as, but not limited to, H-1B, TN, STEM OPT) at this time.
 Location: Irving, TX
 Workstyle: Hybrid schedule - employees work onsite a minimum of four days per week, with one remote day. Five days onsite may be required based on business needs.
 About the Role 
If you live and breathe agentic coding and can’t imagine living another day without your Cursor or Claude code subscription: we want you on our team.
 In this role, you’ll build scalable backend software in Java. You’ll also play a key role in shaping how AI and automation are integrated into our products and engineering workflows.
 What You’ll Do 
 Partner with Product, UX, and fellow Software Engineers to turn ideas into scalable, production-ready code 
 Design and develop internal (and potentially customer-facing) agents to automate processes as model capabilities evolve
 Integrate multi-modal models into product pipeline to help better take care of our users, from analyzing video streams to generating automated, ML-driven reports
 Design systems with scalability, performance, and storage in mind
 Work with QA to build repeatable, automated validation of user-facing features
 Troubleshoot and resolve issues across environments
 Ensure stability and performance of production systems with minimal user impact
 Estimate effort for new projects (in tokens) 
 Follow best practices across coding standards and the full software development lifecycle
  
 What We’re Looking For 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience)
 Strong experience with Java backend development
 Experience building React web and/or mobile applications
 Comfortable working in AI-assisted development environments (e.g., Cursor, Claude, MCPs, feedback loops)
 Ability to write clean, readable code independently (without AI assistance)
 Solid understanding of system architecture and design
 Experience with web services (REST and/or WebSockets)
 Experience with data storage systems: SQL
 Key-value stores
 Document databases
 
 Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and/or GCP)
 Proficiency with Git version control
 
 How You Work 
 Comfortable collaborating within a team (human and AI-assisted environments)
 Proactive, self-driven, and able to take ownership of work
 Strong problem-solving skills with ability to navigate complex challenges
 Curious and continuously learning new technologies
 Able to manage multiple priorities effectively
 Seek guidance from others when needed
 
 Key Traits for Success 
 Customer-focused mindset
 Strong sense of ownership and accountability
 Bias for action and results
 High integrity and professionalism
 Collaborative and effective in team environments
 Adaptable and comfortable with change
 Ongoing commitment to learning and technical growth
  
 Los Angeles Applicants: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.​
  
 Philadelphia Applicants: Background checks will be conducted during the employment process. Any information will be reviewed through an individualized assessment in accordance with the Philadelphia Fair Criminal Record Screening Standards Ordinance.
